citation: Almoraie MM, Spencer JP, Wagstaff C, et al. Acute Effects of a High-Fat Meal Enriched with Pomegranate Seed Oil on Postprandial Lipemia and Endothelial Function in Postmenopausal Women: a Randomized Controlled Crossover Trial. The Journal of Nutrition. 2026;156(3):101374.
protocol: High-fat breakfast (toasted white-bread sandwich, 100 g bread, plus test fat; pomegranate seed oil or control oil; energy and macros in Table 1), crossover. Blood at -30, 0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 180, 240, 300, 360, 420, 480 min.
population: 16 postmenopausal women, aged ≤65 y, BMI 18-35 kg/m2 (Table 2 gives means); UK (Reading).

reports.where: Table 3: fasting, MaxC, TMax, AUC and iAUC over 8 h for both meals

note: Older women after a fat-rich meal over 8 h, a group and meal type that are otherwise rare here. Use the control-meal arm. BMI goes up to 35, so not all are lean. Only in figures: time courses. Meal kinds: fat load, mixed meal.
